buyer_portal.headline: One-level living in Regency at Dominion Valley’s 55+ community.
buyer_portal.description: Welcome to effortless luxury and resort-style living in the highly sought-after 55+ community of Regency at Dominion Valley. This beautifully maintained, one-level residence offers the perfect combination of comfort, elegance and convenience. Ideally located on the lower level with patio access to the outdoor space, this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath home features an open and inviting floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The light-filled main living area creates an easy flow between the living room, dining area and gourmet kitchen, while large windows bring in abundant natural light. The spacious primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a generous bedroom, private bath and ample closet space. A second bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a home office or hobbies. Enjoy the convenience of your own detached garage, additional storage, elevator access and truly maintenance-free living. Water, cable, phone and internet are included in the condo fees.

The Home: One-level living on the lower level, with patio access to the outdoors
Open floor plan connecting living room, dining area and gourmet kitchen
Primary suite with private bath and ample closet space
Second bedroom for guests, a home office or hobbies
Large windows and abundant natural light throughout
Effortless Ownership: Water, cable, phone and internet included in the condo fees

buyer_portal.amenities_lede: Regency at Dominion Valley is a gated 55+ community inside Dominion Valley, minutes from shopping, dining and the commuter routes.
